_readme: Everything the business may want to change lives here. Edit, then run: node tools/build.mjs

brand.name: ARK
brand.tagline: Premium marine care, detailing and specialist services.

site._url: Set to the live address (e.g. https://arkmarine.co.uk) once known. It enables canonical links, absolute share images and the sitemap.

form._endpoint: Leave empty and the enquiry form hands the visitor's message to WhatsApp (or email) ready to send. Paste a Formspree / Web3Forms / Getform endpoint URL here to have the form post directly instead. See README.
form._accessKey: Only for Web3Forms: its public access key.

photos._readme: Each slot names a file set in assets/img/photos (name-<width>.webp). 'tall' is an optional portrait version for phones. 'focus' is the crop focal point (object-position).
